claims.text: Capturing profiles
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (creating-profiles/tile/1); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Capture the current targets under a name.
claims.note: Tile summary. Update from Current plus the slot's editable name.

claims.text: Capture the station targets you have tuned, under a name you will recognize next season.
claims.note: Into one of the five slots, renamed as you like. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Settings › Target Profiles
claims.note: Settings gear, then the third rail entry.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab lists five named profile slots for each Lynx course.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (creating-profiles/note/1); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: Target Profiles is still in development and is not in the shipping build yet.

claims.text: If your settings dialog has no Target Profiles entry, your IntelliDash has not yet been updated to the release that includes it.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (creating-profiles/note/2); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.
claims.previousText: The screens here show a proposed design; the tab being built lists five named profile slots, so what you see on your own screen may differ.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: Station targets set the way you want to keep them, and a slot you can spare.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A profile stores one Target VWC per station and nothing else — no percent adjustments, no enable states.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. A stored row holds the profile id, the station name and a Target VWC only (SpatialAdjustService.cs:662-667), and applying changes no enable state or % Adj. override (:921-936).

claims.text: Tune the targets first
claims.note: Step title. Capture reads the targets as they stand at Save Changes.

claims.text: Set [[Target VWC]] on each station the way you want to keep it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: A profile is a snapshot, so the work happens in the table before you save anything.

claims.text: The [[Target VWC]] column shows the targets the profile will capture.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Get the course reading the way you want it, hole by hole, and only then capture it.

claims.text: If a station is not in the table, it has no recent scan.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The profile still captures its stored target.
claims.note: Update from Current reads every stored station row for the site and course, not only those scanned lately (SpatialAdjustService.cs:566-580, :651-674). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A profile is a snapshot of the targets at the moment you save it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The Target VWC column is what a profile would capture.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. The Target VWC values are what is captured, for every station record in the course, including any the table is not showing because it has no recent scans (SpatialAdjustService.cs:180-211).

claims.text: Open Settings
At the right of the toolbar, select the gear button, [[Settings]].
claims.note: The gear button has tooltip STRINGS.SETTINGS "Settings" and opens the Settings dialog (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:69-72).
claims.previousText: Profiles sit with the calculation settings rather than in the table, because a target set is a calculation input rather than a station edit.

claims.text: The Settings dialog opens, with a rail of tabs down its left side.
If another dialog is open, close it first.
claims.note: Dialogs here are modal (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:3), so a second dialog cannot be reached while one is open.

claims.text: The gear is just right of [[Announcements]].
The gear button sits in the toolbar’s right-hand group.
Open the Target Profiles tab
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In the left rail, select [[Target Profiles]], below [[Minimum Threshold]].
claims.note: The rail lists Calculation, Minimum Threshold, Target Profiles, then Preferences (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:52-57). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims target-profiles/note/1, target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Name a profile for the reason the targets are what they are — Summer Baseline, Tournament Week, Overseed Recovery.

claims.text: The right side lists 5 profile slots, with [[Update from Current]] and [[Apply Profile]] columns.
claims.note: Five slots per course, indexes 0 to 4 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:28-31, sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:383-392). Column headings at sa-settings-dlg.component.html:195-199.
claims.previousText: A date tells you when; a condition tells you why, which is what you will be searching for.

claims.text: If the rail has no [[Target Profiles]], your IntelliDash predates it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Change targets in the table instead.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim target-profiles/note/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (creating-profiles/2/3); docs/text-corrections.md §11 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Name it for the condition
claims.note: Step title. Slot names are editable.

claims.text: In the [[Target Profile]] column, type a new name over a slot you can spare.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims creating-profiles/3/1, creating-profiles/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The count beside each profile says how many stations it covers.

claims.text: The box shows the new name, such as Tournament Week.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: A profile holds every station the course had when it was captured, enabled or not.

claims.text: If the slot shows a station count, it already holds a profile, and capturing into it replaces what it holds.
claims.note: A slot with a station count already stores targets. When the slot is marked Update from Current, its stored stations are removed and replaced with the current targets (SpatialAdjustService.cs:636-678); renaming alone changes only the name and date (:625-627).
claims.previousText: If the slot shows a station count, it already holds a profile, and saving will replace it.

claims.text: Use a slot that shows -- if you have one.
claims.note: An empty slot reads -- under Last Updated and Stations (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:205-206); filling one loses nothing.
claims.previousText: Coverage is part of what a profile is.

claims.text: A name like Overseed says why you set the targets; the date has its own column.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims creating-profiles/3/2, creating-profiles/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard. Wording changed after expert feedback in the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review.

claims.text: The Target Profiles tab with its five slots.
claims.note: Corrected wording, replacing the sentence the ledger marked Wrong (creating-profiles/3/4); docs/text-corrections.md §12 gives the claimed and actual behaviour. Verified against production at the cited lines.

claims.text: Mark it for capture
On the profile’s row, select the icon under [[Update from Current]].
An exclamation mark appears on the icon: the slot will take the current targets when you save.
claims.note: The icon shows an exclamation with tooltip "Will update on save" once the slot is marked (sa-settings-dlg.component.html:210).

claims.text: If the mark goes away, you selected the icon twice.
claims.note: onUpdateTargetProfile flips updateFromCurrent on each selection (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:249-251).

claims.text: Select it once more.
The profile will hold every station on the course at that moment, enabled or not.
claims.note: The capture reads every stored station for the site and course with no filter on enabled state (SpatialAdjustService.cs:566-580, :651-674). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim creating-profiles/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The Update from Current icon marks a slot to capture on save.
Save the change
Select [[Save Changes]] at the bottom of the dialog.
A busy sign shows while the profile is saved, then the dialog closes.
If the dialog stays open with [[Unable to save data]], the save did not finish.
claims.note: On error onSave shows the generic save error, GENERIC_SAVE_ERROR_SUMMARY "Unable to save data", and does not emit save, so the dialog stays open (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:208-213).

claims.text: Reload the page and check the profile list before you try again.
claims.note: The profile operation can fail or time out after ten minutes with advice to refresh before trying again (sa-settings-dlg.component.ts:510-518); a failed save does not reload the list, so reloading is the way to see what was stored.

claims.text: Nothing is captured until Save Changes.
The new profile appears in the list with today’s date and the full station count.
claims.note: After Save Changes the slot's Last Updated is stamped (SpatialAdjustService.cs:625) and Stations shows the count captured. The slot was already in the list before; it now shows a date and count instead of "--".

claims.text: The targets in the table are unchanged by saving.
claims.note: Capture only reads the stations (SpatialAdjustService.cs:566-580). If Apply Profile was also staged on the same slot, the apply runs after the capture and writes the same values back (:681-686).
